substrate.summary: Deterministic release workflow and bundle tests validated release proof asset emission, upload, redownload, and verification without requiring KVM.

command: python3 scripts/test-release-bundle.py && python3 scripts/test-workflow-policy.py && python3 scripts/lint-github-workflows.py && python3 -m py_compile scripts/package-release-bundle.py scripts/verify-release-integrity.py scripts/write-release-attestation-metadata.py && cargo test -p m80-cli --test release --no-fail-fast && cargo test -p m80-cli --test release_bundle_builder --no-fail-fast && cargo fmt --all -- --check && git diff --check && br dep cycles --json
stdout: release workflow emits m80-release-integrity.json, m80-release-integrity.attestation.jsonl, and m80-release-attestation.json; publish verifies proof assets before upload and after redownload; workflow policy and release bundle tests passed
observables: tag release workflow emits m80-release-integrity.json into the release dist artifact
tag release workflow emits m80-release-integrity.attestation.jsonl into the release dist artifact
tag release workflow emits m80-release-attestation.json into the release dist artifact
build job proof-asset permissions are limited to attestation/id-token without contents write
publish job verifies release integrity material before gh release upload
redownload validation fetches proof assets and reruns the verifier against published assets
workflow and bundle tests fail if proof files disappear from upload, download, or verifier steps
